==Dialogue==
:''"[[Daeman]], champion of the [[Crab Clan|Crab]] is much stronger than either [[Argo]] or [[Aurora]]."''
:''"If it wasn't for the [[Kurzick]]s I'm sure that the [[Turtle Clan|Turtle]] and the [[Serpent Clan|Serpent]] would be fighting each other."''
:''"Simple [[Jadeite Shard|jade]] has lost its value...we have an entire sea of it now!"''
:''"The jade in some places is infused with energy, that's the truly valuable stuff."''
:''"The reavers of the Crab are the best at finding and reaving the most potent jade from the sea."''
:''"Those who mine the jade from the sea are referred to as [[reaver]]s. It's a tradition from our nautical heritage."''
